tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Hacker News search over cached stories and/or comments and returns a paged result set based on `page` (0-based) and `hitsPerPage`, recording the request to support pagination and rate limiting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `query` is missing/empty, `type` is not one of `all|story|comment`, or `page`/`hitsPerPage` are not valid non-negative numbers; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the caller exceeds search rate limits. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

type.description: The type of content to search for

hitsPerPage.description: The number of results per page

tool_schemas.name: getStory
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Hacker News story for the given numeric `id` (refreshing the cache as needed) and includes the story fields stored by the integration. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing or not a valid number; raises NOT_FOUND when no story with that id exists (or the item exists but is not a story). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if item-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getStoryWithComments
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Hacker News story identified by `id` along with its associated comments as stored by the integration, using the recorded relationships to assemble the thread. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing or not a valid number; raises NOT_FOUND when the story does not exist or is not a story. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if item-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getStories
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a list of stories for the given feed `type` (`top|new|best|ask|show|job`) and returns up to `limit` items, recording the list-fetch request to support efficient repeated queries and pagination. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `type` is not one of the allowed values or `limit` is not a valid positive number; raises QUOTA_EXCEEDED when list-fetch rate limits are exceeded. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

type.description: The type of stories to fetch

limit.description: The maximum number of stories to fetch

tool_schemas.name: getComment
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Hacker News comment for the given numeric `id` (refreshing the cache as needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing or not a valid number; raises NOT_FOUND when no comment with that id exists (or the item exists but is not a comment). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if item-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getComments
tool_schemas.description: Returns up to `limit` cached comments for the given `storyId`, based on the stored story-to-comment relationships. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `storyId` is missing/not a valid number or `limit` is not a valid positive number; raises NOT_FOUND when the story does not exist or is not a story. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if item-fetch limits are exceeded.

limit.description: The maximum number of comments to fetch

tool_schemas.name: getCommentTree
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full cached comment tree for `storyId`, including nested replies assembled from stored comment-to-reply relationships. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `storyId` is missing or not a valid number; raises NOT_FOUND when the story does not exist or is not a story. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if item-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getUser
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached Hacker News user profile for the given user `id` (refreshing the cache as needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/empty; raises NOT_FOUND when the user does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if user-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getUserSubmissions
tool_schemas.description: Returns the cached list of item submissions associated with the given user `id`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/empty; raises NOT_FOUND when the user does not exist. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if user/list-fetch limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: getRequest
tool_schemas.description: Returns a single recorded request by `id` from `hn_requests`, including its immutable parameters and final/current `status`. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

tool_schemas.name: listRequests
tool_schemas.description: Lists recorded requests from `hn_requests` with optional filters, returning results in reverse chronological order for auditing, pagination and debugging. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call

tool_schemas.name: updateRequestStatus
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable execution fields on an existing `hn_requests` record (status, upstream timing and error), preserving immutable request meaning fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if attempting to change immutable fields or if `status` is not a valid lifecycle transition; raises NOT_FOUND if the request does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

status.description: New request status (must be a valid transition from the current status)

tool_schemas.name: listCachedItems
tool_schemas.description: Lists cached Hacker News items from `hn_items` with filters, intended for troubleshooting cache contents and building custom views. Returns items without forcing an upstream refresh. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid filters; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

itemType.description: Filter by Hacker News item type

hnItemId.description: Filter by Hacker News numeric item id

rootStoryHnItemId.description: Filter items by root story hn item id

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call

tool_schemas.name: tombstoneItem
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a cached item in `hn_items` to `tombstoned` (and only to `tombstoned`) to permanently suppress it from default reads. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g. already tombstoned). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `id` is missing/invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the item does not exist; raises UNAUTHORIZED if the integration is not permitted for the caller.

id.description: The Hacker News numeric item id (`hn_item_id`) to tombstone

reason.description: Optional reason for tombstoning (stored in service logs/metadata when available)
